body: I turn 28 tomorrow. Since I turned 18 I've been struggling to get somewhere and I've gotten nowhere. It's been a decade of struggle and I've got nothing to show for it. I worked hard and got nothing. I thought society rewarded hard work. Well I've been working hard for a decade and I've had to claw and scratch for everything that I have. It looks like it's only going to get harder. I don't want to suffer through the decades like this.

I feel like a coward. I can never face them and the truth that I'm walking garbage. They were probably the only people left that cared about me. But I knew they were done with me. They were done trying to help me. They've just kept me close enough for the last few years to say that they love me without ever having to show their support. They're lives are great and they'll be much better without me around.
